title: Looking for Owls
statementMd:
Emperor Palpatine loves owls very much. The emperor has some blueprints with the new Death Star, the blueprints contain $*n*$ distinct segments and $*m*$ distinct circles. We will consider the segments indexed from $1$ to $*n*$ in some way and the circles — indexed from $1$ to $*m*$ in some way.

Palpatine defines an owl as a set of a pair of distinct circles $(*i*, *j*)$ ($*i* < *j*$) and one segment $*k*$, such that:

1. circles $*i*$ and $*j*$ are symmetrical relatively to the straight line containing segment $*k*$;
2. circles $*i*$ and $*j*$ don't have any common points;
3. circles $*i*$ and $*j*$ have the same radius;
4. segment $*k*$ intersects the segment that connects the centers of circles $*i*$ and $*j*$.

Help Palpatine, count the number of distinct owls on the picture.

## Input

The first line contains two integers — $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 3·10^{5}$, $2 ≤ *m* ≤ 1500$).

The next $*n*$ lines contain four integers each, $*x*_{1}$, $*y*_{1}$, $*x*_{2}$, $*y*_{2}$ — the coordinates of the two endpoints of the segment. It's guaranteed that each segment has positive length.

The next $*m*$ lines contain three integers each, $*x*_{*i*}$, $*y*_{*i*}$, $*r*_{*i*}$ — the coordinates of the center and the radius of the $*i*$-th circle. All coordinates are integers of at most $10^{4}$ in their absolute value. The radius is a positive integer of at most $10^{4}$.

It is guaranteed that all segments and all circles are dictinct.

## Output

Print a single number — the answer to the problem.

Please, do not use the `%lld` specifier to output 64-bit integers is С++. It is preferred to use the `cout` stream or the `%I64d` specifier.

## Note

Here's an owl from the first sample. The owl is sitting and waiting for you to count it.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/536c5d374bb7f9f490f77f919b10c31ea3a4cdbe.png)
statementZhMd:
皇帝帕尔帕廷非常喜欢猫头鹰。皇帝有一些包含新死星的蓝图，蓝图中包含 $*n*$ 条互不相同的线段和 $*m*$ 个互不相同的圆。我们将以某种方式将线段编号为 $1$ 到 $*n*$，并以某种方式将圆编号为 $1$ 到 $*m*$。

帕尔帕廷将一个猫头鹰定义为一对不同的圆 $(*i*, *j*)$（$*i* < *j*$）和一条线段 $*k*$，并满足：

1. 圆 $*i*$ 和圆 $*j*$ 关于包含线段 $*k*$ 的直线对称；
2. 圆 $*i*$ 和圆 $*j*$ 没有任何公共点；
3. 圆 $*i*$ 和圆 $*j*$ 的半径相同；
4. 线段 $*k*$ 与连接圆 $*i*$ 和圆 $*j*$ 圆心的线段相交。

请帮助帕尔帕廷计算图中不同猫头鹰的数量。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数——$*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 3·10^{5}$，$2 ≤ *m* ≤ 1500$）。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含四个整数 $*x*_{1}$、$*y*_{1}$、$*x*_{2}$、$*y*_{2}$，表示线段两个端点的坐标。保证每条线段的长度都为正数。

接下来的 $*m*$ 行中，每行包含三个整数 $*x*_{*i}$、$*y*_{*i}$、$*r*_{*i}$，表示第 $*i*$ 个圆的圆心坐标和半径。所有坐标均为整数，绝对值不超过 $10^{4}$。半径为正整数，且不超过 $10^{4}$。

保证所有线段和圆均互不相同。

## 输出格式

输出一个数字——题目的答案。

请不要在 C++ 中使用 `%lld` 格式说明符输出 64 位整数。建议使用 `cout` 流或 `%I64d` 格式说明符。
